overview: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable phone, announced in September 2026: a book-style foldable with a 7.6-inch 120Hz inner OLED and a 5.4-inch cover display. It runs the 2nm A20 Pro with 12GB of RAM, dual 48MP rear cameras with 2x optical zoom, a 12MP cover camera plus an under-display inner camera, and side-mounted Touch ID instead of Face ID. The grade-5 titanium body is IP68 rated and weighs 254g, in Star White and Night Sky. Pre-orders opened October 16, 2026 with first sales on October 23; Pakistan is not in the first wave, so no PK price is published.

gaming.gaming_notes: The A20 Pro is flagship silicon, so every game runs at its best — but the foldable form factor and price make this a luxury device first, a gaming phone second. (Editorial estimate, not a measured benchmark.)
